We utilize a dataset of elementary math classroom transcripts  and GPT-4 prompting techniques to create four different types of responses: 1. ORIGINAL: Teacher utterance from the classroom transcript labeled as unsupportive by teachers trained in GMSL. 2. EXPERT: Reframings of unsupportive examples to GMSL by teachers trained in GMSL. 3. MODEL (0-CRITIQUES): Reframings of unsupportive examples to GMSL by GPT-4. 4. MODEL (1-CRITIQUE): Reframings of unsupportive examples to GMSL by GPT-4 prompted to self-improve upon responses.
datasets: National Center for Teacher Effectiveness (NCTE) 4-5th grade math classroom transcripts
outputs: reframed teacher utterances that transform unsupportive language into growth mindset supportive language
